entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just... so confused by all of this.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, I don't think it's broken. I just don't really get it, and I haven't used it. I was reading the website about the return policy and it all seemed so complicated. I'm not sure if it's too late. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can definitely help clarify the policy for you. Let me just pull up your account... one moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 19 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that bad? I just feel so overwhelmed.
Not at all. I've just checked, and for this specific product, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within the timeframe to make a return for a full refund.
Wait, really? 90 days? Oh, that's such a relief. I must have been looking at the wrong thing.

No problem, it can be confusing. I've gone ahead and initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Wow, okay. That was so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much, Charlie! You've really helped me out.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
